newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian Congress ratifies re-election bill.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian Congress ratifies re-election bill.

text.p: Brazil's Congress Wednesday ratified a constitutional amendment which allows President Fernando Henrique Cardoso to run for a second term in 1998.
Congress president Senator Antonio Carlos Magalhaes declared the amendment approved in a joint session of the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate.
The ratification of the amendment represented the last step in the bill's approval. Earlier Wednesday, the Senate voted for a second and final time in favor of the reform.
The amendment allows presidents, state governors and mayors to run for a consecutive second term.
